text:
incident-bot: Pager: High streaming error rate for inference in az1a -> https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-32321 (high p50/p95 connect+handshake latency, increased gRPC RST_STREAM) :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: Ack. I'm on it. ping @eng-net and @cs-ledger. Collecting impact and root traces.

pete: looking at metrics — TLS handshake failures spiked at 02:11 UTC, SYN retries and TCP retransmits up at same time. p95 connect time ~1.2s, baseline 20ms.

mei: app logs show a lot of gRPC stream resets: "HTTP/2 stream 0: RST_STREAM code:2" and clients retrying aggressively. Some clients hit transient 502 on streaming endpoints.

eng-net: saw a rapid series of ENI detach+reattach events on a subset of hosts in az1a starting at 02:09. Hosts dropped connections while reconfiguring. Hypothesis: ephemeral port churn + rehandshakes caused host-level connection pool to collapse -> thundering handshake.

pete: can we confirm ephemeral port exhaustion? pls paste /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range and netstat counts.

eng-net: quick from a sample host:
```
# cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
32768 60999
# ss -s | grep -A2 TCP
TCP:   123456 (estab 114000, closed 5000, orphaned 300, time_wait 9000)
```
We see high ESTAB and TIME_WAIT, suggests many short-lived connections.

mei: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) steer new sessions away from az1a to eu1/usw2 if capacity permits 2) enable TLS session resumption / keepalive on ALB side to reduce full handshakes 3) increase ephemeral port window on affected hosts (but risky atm).

sre-oncall: executing traffic-steer playbook now. Running `scripts/steer-controlplane --from=az1a --to=eu1 --pct=50` then ramp. I'll coordinate with eng-net.

eng-net: acknowledged. Pushing steer: controlplane accepted, target weights: az1a -> 50%, eu1 -> 50%. Observability: connection attempts to az1a dropping, eu1 connections increasing.

cs-ledger: customer impact — we have 3 enterprise customers on streaming SLAs with errors (Acme, BrightHealth, LedgerPay). I'll start a status note and open tickets, ETA?

pete: after initial steer, error rate dropped ~35% in 8 minutes. Keep ramping to 80% over next 10m. We'll keep small canary for az1a to observe host recovery.

eng-net: increasing steer to eu1=80% now. Also deploying a canary config patch to ALB to enable TLS resumption for streaming sockets on 10 hosts in az1a.

mei: canary patch rolled to 10 hosts, observed handshake rate drop by ~60% on those hosts. Rolling to another 20.

incident-bot: Reminder: on-call rotation handoff in 30m. Next: @night-sre will take the pager at 03:00 UTC.

night-sre: I’ll take the handoff at 03:00. Current ask: monitor steering, TLS resumption rollout, and customer comms.

sre-oncall: logged mitigation steps. Start collecting packet captures and ENI detach timeline for postmortem. Assigning postmortem owner to @pete.

pete: noted. I’ll pull host-level dmesg and cloud audit logs (ENI detach API events) and correlate with our controlplane reroute timestamps.

cs-ledger: draft sent to Acme/BrightHealth/LedgerPay describing degraded streaming in az1a, mitigation via region steering, and expected follow-up with root cause.

mei: quick note — long-term fix: reduce handshake rate by enabling session resumption defaults in our SDK, and add client backoff to avoid retry storms. Add to backlog.

sre-oncall: status summary: 03:20 UTC — traffic steer to eu1 at 80%, error rate down ~70% from peak, small number of hosts in az1a still flapping ENIs. Handoff to @night-sre at 03:00 UTC. Postmortem assigned.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated (partial)". Pager quieting.

night-sre: acked takeover. Will monitor until fully stable and add timeline notes.

pete: grabbing logs now, will file initial postmortem draft by EOD.

sre-oncall: thanks team :thumbsup: add any further artifacts to INC-32321.
